name: LTE
description: LTE —— MTR（Minecraft Transit Railway）的灯光与物理优化：动态车头灯 / 车尾灯与可见光柱、屏幕空间散射、雨雾与水花、列车碰撞与撞飞、道床判定，以及信号灯 / 投影机 / PIDS 连接器与 3D 光束编辑器。服务端同时安装时，碰撞、撞飞与伤害在服务端结算；只装客户端也能照常使用。\nLTE — lighting and physics improvements for Minecraft Transit Railway: dynamic head and tail lights with visible beams, screen-space scattering, rain mist and spray, collisions that knock you flying, trackbed geometry, plus signal / projector / PIDS linkers and an in-game 3D beam editor. Install it on the server too and collisions, knock-back and damage are resolved server-side; client-only installs still work.
authors: 厦航在拍车的无名机长 (kigurumiLTY)
